governance.note: Levers, all published/measured, none fitted: multi-product AS co-opt on the measured ASPLANNP433 requirements; published pre-reform ECRS deployment design (no price-based release 2023-06-10..2024-07-31 per IMM 2023 SOM / NPRR1224 rejection); the lumped ORDC total-reserve family (RTORPA, NPRR568/OBDRR048 - published curve, default flat-sigma fallback documented, NP6-576-ER re-fetch egress-blocked); measured NP3-911 Load-Resource RRS-UFR credit; measured F923 coal pricing, CAMPD outage overlay, measured GTC limits, measured CHP export floors. Plus the measured Henry Hub monthly gas SHAPE (level-preserving, the Run-77 reconciled variant). Same endogenous-storage artifact as ercot28. The gas shape moves every month toward gas-cost truth (Feb-2024 +6.6 -> +3.2) and EXPOSES two non-gas over-pricings kept per rule #14: Jan-2024 (the DAM-AS overlay's DA-boundary premium stacking on truthful dearer Jan gas) and Feb/Mar-2025 (+5/+6 with truthful dearer gas - open root-cause thread).

exceptions.reason: Inherited from the ercot26 keeper unchanged (this stack's reserve carve-outs are volume-neutral on the class: -8.53 vs keeper -8.55 TWh): the model under-curtails 2023 renewables by ~4.1 TWh (model 2.46 vs ISO-reported 6.96 TWh) because ERCOT's real curtailment is nodal/intra-zone (VALEXP/McCamey/138 kV) - constraints the 7-zone reduction cannot represent (CONFIRMED by the ercot26 measured-GTC probe: the zonal interfaces saturate <1% of hours) - plus the ~3.7 TWh 923-vs-930 gas-actuals basis inconsistency. The honest fix is a sub-zonal/nodal topology (separate work stream); closing it with an offer retune or renewable haircut fitted to the residual is forbidden.

2025 preliminary EIA-923 vintage (9/41 CC_REGULAR, 24/38 CT_PEAKER plants missing): no trustworthy per-class actual, family falls back to the EIA-930 aggregate; the residual is dominated by the 930-vs-preliminary-923 vintage difference.
